about: Screenshots for the online manual. tools/import-guide.py puts each picture after the first paragraph under its heading (chapter = the page's address under /manual/, heading = the id of the heading on that page). A picture whose file is not in images/manual/ yet is skipped, so a shot can be listed before it is taken. Real screenshots of the demo project only. 'shot' says what to capture; correct 'alt' if the picture shows something else. After adding files, run tools/import-guide.sh and commit images/manual/, manual/ and sitemap.xml together.

screenshots.heading: understanding-the-interface
screenshots.shot: Whole main window, demo project open in Table view, one video clip selected so the preview and metadata panel are filled, sidebar showing Library and Smart Groups.
screenshots.alt: The MediaFlowSwift main window with a project open: the pipeline strip across the top, the sidebar on the left, the clip table in the middle, and the video preview and metadata panel on the right.
screenshots.caption: The main window: pipeline strip, sidebar, media list, preview panel and metadata panel.

screenshots.heading: understanding-the-pipeline-strip
screenshots.shot: Crop to the pipeline strip only, mid-project: some clips uncategorized, some unrated, some not yet organized, so the segments show real counts and buttons.
screenshots.alt: The pipeline strip: seven segments, Import, Categorize, Review, Organize, Free up space, Archive and Eject, each with a count of the work left and a button.
screenshots.caption: The pipeline strip shows how far the project has come and offers the next action.

screenshots.heading: setting-up-mediaflow
screenshots.shot: The Setup Wizard's first step, 'Where your footage goes', with its three choices visible.
screenshots.alt: The Setup Wizard's first step, asking where your footage goes: This Mac, An external drive, or A network share.
screenshots.caption: The Setup Wizard's first answer decides which steps follow.

screenshots.heading: importing-from-a-card-drive-or-folder
screenshots.shot: File > Import... with Cards & drives (or Folder) chosen, a source scanned, the file list with checkboxes and the Camera picker set.
screenshots.alt: The Import sheet with a card chosen as the source, its files listed with checkboxes, and the Camera picker set to the camera that shot them.
screenshots.caption: The Import sheet: pick the source, check the files, set the camera.

screenshots.heading: the-import-sheet-and-completion-card
screenshots.shot: The completion card at the end of an import ("Imported N clips (x GB) from Camera ...") with its Eject, Categorize now and Done buttons.
screenshots.alt: The completion card at the end of an import, giving the number of clips imported, their size and camera, with Eject, Categorize now and Done buttons.
screenshots.caption: When the import finishes, the completion card offers the next step.

screenshots.heading: table-and-grid-views
screenshots.shot: The media list in Grid view: thumbnail cards with stars and Hero/Maybe/Reject badges on some of them.
screenshots.alt: The media list in Grid view: a thumbnail card for each clip, some showing star ratings and Hero, Maybe or Reject badges.
screenshots.caption: Grid view; the Table / Grid control in the toolbar switches between the two.

screenshots.heading: filtering-and-searching
screenshots.shot: A filter chosen in the sidebar (shown as a chip) plus a word typed in the toolbar search field, with the 'N of M clips' line above the narrowed list.
screenshots.alt: The media list narrowed by a filter and a search: the filter shows as a chip in the sidebar, the search word is in the toolbar field, and a line above the list counts the matching clips.
screenshots.caption: A search works inside the current filter.

screenshots.heading: star-ratings--selects
screenshots.shot: Table view sorted by Rating, best first, so the Rating and Select columns show stars and Hero/Maybe/Reject; crop to those columns plus Filename.
screenshots.alt: Clips in Table view sorted by rating, best first, with star ratings in the Rating column and Hero, Maybe or Reject in the Select column.
screenshots.caption: Sorted by rating: five stars and Hero at the top, Reject last.

screenshots.heading: organizing-media-to-storage
screenshots.shot: The Organize Media confirmation: scope, number of clips, total size, destination menu and its free space, the 'Make this the project destination' box.
screenshots.alt: The Organize Media confirmation, showing the number of clips, their total size, the destination with its free space, and the Organize Media button.
screenshots.caption: Organize Media copies clips into Category and Camera folders and verifies every copy.

screenshots.heading: video-playback-controls
screenshots.shot: Preview panel only, a video paused mid-clip, with an in/out range marked on the seek slider and the time display visible.
screenshots.alt: The preview panel with a video paused mid-clip, and under it the seek slider with a marked range, step back, play, step forward, the time display and the pop-out button.
screenshots.caption: The preview panel's controls.

screenshots.heading: processing-the-proxy-queue
screenshots.shot: Proxy queue chosen in the sidebar with several clips in it, and the Workflow Tools tab showing the Process Queue buttons (ideally with the progress bar running).
screenshots.alt: The Proxy queue with several clips in it, and the Workflow Tools tab with the Process Queue (Thumbnails), Process Queue (Proxies) and Process Queue (All) buttons.
screenshots.caption: Clips in the Proxy queue, ready to process.

screenshots.heading: working-with-categories
screenshots.shot: Several clips selected, the Edit tab's Category picker open showing the default categories, and the Apply Category button.
screenshots.alt: The Category picker open in the Edit tab, listing categories such as A-roll, B-roll, Interview and Skip (don't copy), with the Apply Category button below.
screenshots.caption: Choosing a category for the selected clips.

screenshots.heading: generating-reports
screenshots.shot: Workflow > Plan & Deliver > Report: the Export / Generate Report dialog with its format choices.
screenshots.alt: The Export / Generate Report dialog with its list of formats, including PDF, HTML and spreadsheet, and the Generate button.
screenshots.caption: Pick a format and click Generate.

screenshots.heading: preparing-a-video-for-youtube
screenshots.shot: Prepare for YouTube after Write with the SEO Agent on the demo video: chosen video, title options, description, chapters, tags and the checklist.
screenshots.alt: The Prepare for YouTube window with a finished video chosen, suggested titles, a description with chapters, tags, and the publishing checklist.
screenshots.caption: Prepare for YouTube: the words drafted for the finished video, ready to edit.

screenshots.heading: archiving-a-project-to-usb
screenshots.shot: Workflow > Archive to USB... with a numbered drive listed and marked Recommended, before clicking Archive.
screenshots.alt: The Archive to USB sheet listing a numbered archive drive marked Recommended, with its free space and the Archive button.
screenshots.caption: Archive to USB copies the finished project to a numbered drive and checks every file.
